d: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth makes a surprise visit to Caracas, where he meets acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez and announces a renewed military partnership between the two countries. The agreement includes joint military training, intelligence sharing and defence equipment cooperation, marking a dramatic reversal after US forces captured Nicolás Maduro in January.
